text:
Liam O'Connor: FYI - planning a schema change to accounts.metadata (add jsonb col `preferences`) during the 00:30 UTC change window. Small backfill (~8m) + new index on metadata->>'last_seen'. Need ops + canary.

Maya Singh: Can we pin api-service to v1.9.2 for the rollout? v1.10 had a retry loop that bumped locks last time.

Zoe Patel: +1 pin to v1.9.2. Also suggest setting backfill throttle to 200 r/s and max parallel shards 4.

Liam O'Connor: Agreed. Rollback triggers proposed: 1) sustained 5m P95 latency regression >150ms, 2) error rate >0.8% for 3m, 3) >15 DB lock events (duration>45s) across replicas in 10m. If triggered we abort and run snap-2026-03-22-accounts-01 restore.

Maya Singh: Add replica-lag guard: if any replica lag >45s for >2min pause backfill. Also add deploybot holdpoint at canary+8m for manual resume.

deploy-bot: Job created: migrator/job/1898765432-accounts-preferences. Canary nodes=1 (sample=1%). CLI: `deploybot start migrator/job/1898765432-accounts-preferences --canary --pin-version v1.9.2 --holdpoint canary:8m`

Zoe Patel: Internal release note draft: "Add preferences (jsonb) to accounts.metadata and index last_seen for faster activity queries. Non-breaking. Ops will monitor replication and lock metrics." Keep public note concise.

migrations-bot: Added alert rule: DB_LOCK_RATE -> channel #eng-sre and @ops-oncall. Pager threshold: lock_count > 12 in 10m OR avg_lock_time > 40s.

Maya Singh: Rollback scripts/paths: infra/db/rollback/accounts_preferences_20260323.sql and snapshot id snap-2026-03-22-accounts-01. I'll upload runbook in 10.

Liam O'Connor: Please confirm we've added client-side backoff config and feature-flag gating so index rollout can be toggled.

Zoe Patel: Feature flag ready: ff.accounts.preferences_index=true (default off). We'll enable during canary.

Maya Singh: Runbook link: https://internal.docs/runbooks/migrations/accounts_preferences_20260323.md - contains watchlist, rollback steps, `psql` commands, and traffic fallback steps.

deploy-bot: Updated job migrator/job/1898765432-accounts-preferences with parameter `--holdpoint canary:8m`. Will wait for `deploybot resume`.

ops-alerts: Notification schema: on-call paging to @ops-oncall and @eng-sre if DB_LOCK_RATE or REPLICA_LAG breach.

Liam O'Connor: Final checklist: pin v1.9.2 ✅, backfill throttle 200r/s ✅, canary holdpoint 8m ✅, rollback/snap defined ✅. Thanks team :rocket:
